data.body: **[P1] Do not contain fatal exporter callbacks in `CompletableFuture.runAsync`.** With multiple exporters, `runSafely` rethrows `VirtualMachineError`/`ThreadDeath`, but `CompletableFuture` catches it and only fails the task. The signal kills the pump while the actual fan-out worker survives and returns to the shared pool, defeating an injected `ThreadDeath`. Use an observed runnable that completes a separate future and then rethrows the fatal from the executor task itself; add multi-exporter uncaught-worker coverage.
